android.desc:
I Love U Buzz is back with more ❤️ than ever!

Three short vibrations mean "I Love You" like squeezing your lovers arm so they know you're thinking of them. The ILoveU app sends three short vibrations to your partners phone. Like a real life touch.

When your phone vibrates 3 times on your desk at work, nobody will realise what it means. Just a private fleeting touch from your lover.

The first time the app is run you will need to pair with your lover by entering your anniversary. Once paired touching the ILoveU icon immediately sends an ILoveU.

Version 2 is a complete re-write so please reach out to support@vadarocks.com if you have any questions or issues.
